rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying something is fairly or quite so, without suggesting an extreme.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is reasonably good.
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6 wo3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is acceptable or fair enough, as with a reasonably priced item, rather than merely quite to some degree.

example.english: This jacket is reasonably priced at three hundred dollars.
example.traditional: 呢件外套賣三百蚊，算係幾抵買。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 maai6 saam1 baak3 man1 syun3 hai6 gei2 dai2 maai5
